acceleration.rule: Every proposed maintenance duration and cadence interval is multiplied by 0.1 unless the interval is an event-triggered immediate obligation.
acceleration.rounding_policy: Preserve exact decimal duration in ISO-8601 hours and minutes where possible; use 36 days 12 hours for one tenth of 365 days.

D1.binding_rule: Run a nine-day accelerated pilot. Use event-triggered synchronization immediately, a structural sweep every 16 hours 48 minutes, an administrative review every 3 days, a deep conformance review every 9 days, and a constitutional review every 36 days 12 hours during the pilot unless superseded by a later Council decision.

D2.binding_rule: Complete protected material synchronization in the same governed change sequence. Refresh canonical trackers within 7 hours 12 minutes after protected merge. A documented infrastructure or statutory-closure interruption may pause only the mirror clock and cannot alter protected authority.

D3.binding_rule: Use typed and expiring waivers. The Human Steward may approve an ordinary repository-local administrative waiver for at most 3 days with one renewal. Cross-repository, provenance, certification, or required-check waivers always require Council authority. No waiver may promote a claim.

D4.binding_rule: Require a non-author Referee for authority, lifecycle, claim, role-boundary, waiver-class, emergency-power, required-check, branch-protection, or promotion-sensitive maintenance changes. Routine semantic-preserving repins and mirror refreshes use ordinary administrative review.

D5.binding_rule: Issues remain navigation and discussion mirrors only. Ordinary noncontradictory staleness is a P2 defect. Contradiction or authority inflation is P1 fail-closed. Identified contradictions block reconciliation closure. The canonical refresh interval is 7 hours 12 minutes.

D6.binding_rule: Emergency override is limited to availability, security, or CI restoration. It expires after 7 hours 12 minutes, requires Human Steward review within 2 hours 24 minutes, and requires Council and Referee retrospective within 16 hours 48 minutes. It cannot promote, admit, adjudicate certification, weaken branch protection, or delete evidence.

D7.binding_rule: A campaign missing a critical required capability fails closed immediately. Freeze new umbrella admissions when two active campaigns or more than 20 percent of the active portfolio are incomplete, whichever threshold is stricter; when protected required-check evidence is missing; when two consecutive accelerated administrative reviews fail; when a P1 mismatch remains unresolved for 16 hours 48 minutes; or when a defect repeats across two accelerated deep reviews.

D8.binding_rule: Use GCL-TCS-00 principles during the accelerated pilot. Do not make GCL-TCS-00 binding until issue 108 completes G8 non-author Referee review and G9 Human Steward release. The canonical mathematical claim ledger remains controlling.

pilot.start_rule: Use the protected merge timestamp of PR 184.
pilot.review_due_rule: Nine days after the protected merge timestamp.
pilot.owner: Human Steward or explicitly delegated Programme administrator

required_evidence: fail-closed stale or missing Programme maintenance contract tests
exact-head INTELLECT CI and GCL conformance
protected INTELLECT merge or explicit Council-approved non-adoption disposition
